title: Jazzy Hangover-Cure Ethiopian Grape Nut Cereal Shiro
description: A pungent and comforting, Whole30-friendly breakfast dish featuring grape nut cereal, inspired by traditional Ethiopian cuisine. Helps alleviate hangover symptoms with its bold, spicy flavors.

ingredients.name: Grape Nut Cereal
ingredients.notes: Any brand will do, but Grape Nuts are preferred for their crunchy texture.

ingredients.name: Berbere Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Ethiopian red chili powder, found in most Middle Eastern grocery stores or online.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince them before adding, and ensure to leave some for garnish.

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.notes: Finely chop them, but leave some texture for added crunch.

ingredients.name: Ghee or Coconut Oil
ingredients.notes: For a pungent flavor, add more ghee; for a lighter taste, use coconut oil.

ingredients.name: Candy Pieces (like M&M's or chopped peanut butter cups)
ingredients.notes: Chopped candy to add a sweet twist in an Ethiopian-inspired grain bowl.

ingredients.name: Fresh Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Chop the leaves and stems for an added pop of flavor.

ingredients.name: Crushed Red Pepper Flakes
ingredients.notes: Add to taste for an extra kick of heat.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Add to bring out the flavors and balance the sweetness.

ingredients.name: Cooked Injera Crumbs
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds an authentic Ethiopian touch.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: Used to create the shiro paste.

ingredients.name: Worcestershire Sauce
ingredients.notes: Adds depth to the shiro paste; adjust to taste.

instructions: Saute the onions in ghee or coconut oil until they are translucent and start to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and saute for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the berbere spice blend and stir for 1-2 minutes, until the spices start to release their aroma.
Add the grape nut cereal and stir for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to break down and release its starches.
Add the chopped candy and cooked Injera crumbs (if using) and stir for 1-2 minutes, until well combined.
Add the water and Worcestershire sauce, and stir for 3-5 minutes, until the shiro paste forms a smooth, thick consistency.
Add the crushed red pepper flakes and salt, and stir for an additional 1-2 minutes, until well combined.
Transfer the shiro paste to a bamboo steamer and steam for 10-15 minutes, until heated through and fragrant.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Optional: Serve the shiro paste over cooked injera or rice for an authentic Ethiopian experience.
